collection.method: REST search, paginated/partitioned; PR author, merge, public base, and files checked

pull_requests.title: Add reviewed asset fq:scenes/room_table_can_candidate
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Added a simulation-scene asset package with assembly manifests, MuJoCo/USD assets, provenance, previews, validation evidence, and catalog/checksum updates. Public merge verified; asset physics and approval process were not independently rerun.

pull_requests.title: Reject non-finite contact materials at finalization
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Rejected NaN and infinite contact-material values on colliding shapes during ModelBuilder.finalize(), with array/shape diagnostics. Covered direct, imported USD, and replicated inputs while preserving visual-only exemptions and validation opt-outs; this is not an importer-wide audit.

pull_requests.title: Fix contact sensor directions after reduction sorting
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Kept contact direction attached to contact IDs through mindist/maxforce reduction sorting by complement-encoding negative directions. Removed the separate direction buffer while retaining the single-int GPU sort; regressions compare native MuJoCo across heterogeneous worlds and CPU/CUDA graph replay. Public PR measurements describe removal of a regression, not a general speedup.

pull_requests.title: Test MJCF camera intrinsics and mount transforms
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Added MJCF camera-import tests comparing inherited/physical/pixel intrinsics and moving-body mount transforms against native MuJoCo. Test-only merge into eric-heiden/newton, a fork; not a merged contribution to newton-physics/newton.

pull_requests.title: Fix runtime shape colors in the single-model RTX viewer
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Restored runtime shape-color updates in the single-model RTX path through per-instance USD display-color readers. Kept built-instance mappings stable across viewer repacking and used a device-side change flag to avoid full color readback on unchanged frames, without rebuilding geometry.

pull_requests.title: Expose Ceres solver thresholds in incremental mapping
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Exposed five existing Ceres solver-selection image-count thresholds for local and global incremental bundle adjustment through C++ pipeline options, Mapper CLI/project settings, and PyCOLMAP. Preserved defaults and added propagation, round-trip, and reconstruction tests; no GPU performance claim.

pull_requests.title: Preserve high-valence Style3D matrix connections
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Prevented silent truncation of high-valence Style3D projective-dynamics matrix connections. Retry overflowed 32-wide assembly with topology-derived capacity and reject incomplete builders; regressions compare entries against dense assembly, symmetry, and translation-nullspace checks.

pull_requests.title: Improve CUDA driver failure diagnostics
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Added actionable insufficient-driver diagnostics and a common CUDA/HIP error formatter while preserving the zero-device return used by CPU-fallback callers. Added error-code/description tests; does not claim to fix Windows CLI exception termination or verify HIP execution.

pull_requests.title: Fix IK tree-joint and body indexing
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Corrected analytic IK forward-kinematics and Jacobian indexing when joint and body indices differ. Follow articulation-tree ancestors, seed external root poses, and reject unsupported objective links or multiply articulated bodies; loop-closure constraints are not enforced.

pull_requests.title: Preserve expanded views in Lie-group input broadcasting
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Preserved expanded views instead of flattening and copying broadcast Lie-group inputs across SO3, SE3, RxSO3, and Sim3. Made Act outputs contiguous for downstream view compatibility; regressions cover non-contiguous/empty inputs and forward/backward equivalence. PR-reported allocation measurements support input-copy removal, not resolution of the original full bundle-adjustment OOM.

pull_requests.title: Fix runtime shape opacity in the single-model RTX viewer
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Restored runtime shape-opacity updates in the single-model RTX viewer using per-instance opacity/IOR primvars and stable instance mappings. Preserved explicit fractional-opacity settings, reused device-side change detection, and added rendered-pixel regressions.

pull_requests.title: Preserve L-BFGS autodiff line-search residuals
pull_requests.author: cola1917
pull_requests.technical_summary: Gave L-BFGS candidate residuals independent gradient storage so Warp tape.zero() cannot erase line-search costs and accept an increasing step. Added a CPU/CUDA regression through public IKSolver behavior.
